limitations: Elementary-family result invariants only. Not a proof of all solve/solveset inputs, parameter strata, all domains or comparative bit complexity.

records.scope: Single sin/cos/tan/cot/sec/csc/exp of a*x+b equal to a finite numeric target, a provably nonzero, over Complexes; over Reals use exact range exclusion only for a provably real affine argument, or restrict the complete complex families. Does not cover arbitrary symbolic parameter degeneracies or every simplification of an intersection.
records.invariant_argument: Putting w=exp(I*z), sin(z)=k and cos(z)=k become quadratics w^2-2*I*k*w-1=0 and w^2-2*k*w+1=0. Their constant terms are nonzero, so both roots have logarithmic preimages, yielding the two exact inverse-function centers modulo 2*pi. Repeated centers may merge but no branch is dropped. Tangent inversion gives one center modulo pi except for the omitted values ±I. Substitution z=a*x+b is bijective when a!=0 and transforms each entire integer lattice, not a bounded sample. Cotangent at zero is the cosine-zero lattice; at nonzero k it reduces to tan(z)=1/k. Secant/cosecant at nonzero k reduce to cos(z)=1/k or sin(z)=1/k; those preimages cannot be poles. At zero they have no finite solutions. Exact nonzero proofs use assumptions or a certified nonzero real/imaginary part. Exp(z)=k has the complete lattice log(k)+2*pi*I*n for nonzero finite k and no solution for k=0. Changing a center by an integer multiple of its period preserves the full lattice. If normalization cannot be certified its original center is retained. Real sine/cosine targets outside [-1,1] are excluded only for a real affine argument, by rational endpoint proof. To restrict c+n*p to the reals, solve Im(c)+n*Im(p)=0: a real step with a real offset retains all indices, a real step with a certified nonreal offset retains none, and a certified nonzero imaginary step permits just n=-Im(c)/Im(p), provided it is an integer. Unresolved real restrictions remain exact set intersections. No finite sample is used to infer emptiness.
records.precision: Exact symbolic ImageSets over unbounded integer indices; range/normalization decisions use outward rational enclosures and arbitrary-size integers. No finite branch-count sample or machine epsilon defines the returned families.
records.complexity: At most two symbolic lattice families per elementary inverse, with expression arithmetic and optional adaptive interval normalization. There is no group/solution-element enumeration or finite period-index cutoff. Symbolic preprocessing, coefficient bit growth, interval refinement and comparative reference complexity remain separate obligations.
records.improvements_over_reference: For sec/csc(z)=0 reference 1.14 returns {nan}; exact finite solution set is empty. For tan/cot(z)=±I reference can return infinite pseudo-roots; the omitted-value set is empty. These cases have independent analytic tests, not reference equality.
records.proof_kind: Human invariant argument plus exact whole-lattice coset comparisons; not machine-checked.
